HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Communal aspects of Yoga? (1 mark)
   A. Use Communal aspects of Yoga to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Communal aspects of Yoga.
   C. Say Communal aspects of Yoga has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Communal aspects of Yoga with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

3. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

4. Which response best shows understanding of Managing Resources. 9 6.0. Yoga 6.1. Asanas 8 6.2. Communal Aspect of Yoga. 9 7.? (1 mark)
   A. Use Managing Resources. 9 6.0. Yoga 6.1. Asanas 8 6.2. Communal Aspect of Yoga. 9 7. to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Managing Resources. 9 6.0. Yoga 6.1. Asanas 8 6.2. Communal Aspect of Yoga. 9 7. has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Managing Resources. 9 6.0. Yoga 6.1. Asanas 8 6.2. Communal Aspect of Yoga. 9 7..
   D. Apply the teaching of Managing Resources. 9 6.0. Yoga 6.1. Asanas 8 6.2. Communal Aspect of Yoga. 9 7. with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Buddhist Vihaar in Africa? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Buddhist Vihaar in Africa.
   B. Use Buddhist Vihaar in Africa to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Buddhist Vihaar in Africa with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Buddhist Vihaar in Africa has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Scriptures and Moral values? (1 mark)
   A. Say Scriptures and Moral values has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Scriptures and Moral values with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Scriptures and Moral values.
   D. Use Scriptures and Moral values to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Virtues and Principles of Dharma in Buddhism? (1 mark)
   A. Say Virtues and Principles of Dharma in Buddhism has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Virtues and Principles of Dharma in Buddhism.
   C. Apply the teaching of Virtues and Principles of Dharma in Buddhism with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Virtues and Principles of Dharma in Buddhism to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Utsav from other faiths? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Utsav from other faiths.
   B. Use Utsav from other faiths to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Utsav from other faiths has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Utsav from other faiths with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Hiding stolen items

10. Which response best shows understanding of Asanas 8 6.2. Communal Aspect of Yoga. 9 7.0. Principles of Dharma 7.1. Virtues ? (1 mark)
   A. Use Asanas 8 6.2. Communal Aspect of Yoga. 9 7.0. Principles of Dharma 7.1. Virtues  to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Asanas 8 6.2. Communal Aspect of Yoga. 9 7.0. Principles of Dharma 7.1. Virtues  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Asanas 8 6.2. Communal Aspect of Yoga. 9 7.0. Principles of Dharma 7.1. Virtues .
   D. Say Asanas 8 6.2. Communal Aspect of Yoga. 9 7.0. Principles of Dharma 7.1. Virtues  has no place in daily life.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Utsavs from other faiths 8 TOTAL NUMBER OF LESSONS 90 NOTE: The suggested number? (1 mark)
   A. Say Utsavs from other faiths 8 TOTAL NUMBER OF LESSONS 90 NOTE: The suggested number has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Utsavs from other faiths 8 TOTAL NUMBER OF LESSONS 90 NOTE: The suggested number with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Utsavs from other faiths 8 TOTAL NUMBER OF LESSONS 90 NOTE: The suggested number.
   D. Use Utsavs from other faiths 8 TOTAL NUMBER OF LESSONS 90 NOTE: The suggested number to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Virtues & Principles of Dharma in Buddhist faith. 8 8.0. Utsav 8.1. Utsavs f? (1 mark)
   A. Say Virtues & Principles of Dharma in Buddhist faith. 8 8.0. Utsav 8.1. Utsavs f has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Virtues & Principles of Dharma in Buddhist faith. 8 8.0. Utsav 8.1. Utsavs f with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Virtues & Principles of Dharma in Buddhist faith. 8 8.0. Utsav 8.1. Utsavs f.
   D. Use Virtues & Principles of Dharma in Buddhist faith. 8 8.0. Utsav 8.1. Utsavs f to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Utsav from other faiths and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Scriptures and Moral values and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Basic chants/mantras as per Buddhism and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Buddhist Vihaars in Africa 8 5.0. Sadachaar 5.1. Managing Resources. 9 6.0. Yoga and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
